subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y1 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: wudu ladder (six steps))
intro: Lesson 9: Taharah: the steps of wudu. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: Getting ready for salah
points: Wudu is washing to get ready
We mean it in our heart: niyyah

box.title: Draw a jug of clean water

keywords.def: washing parts of the body before we pray
what we mean to do in our heart

questions.q: Show me the first three steps of wudu with your hands.
We wash our arms up to the ...
Draw a jug and write the steps 1 to 6 on the pupil PDF wudu ladder.
questions.a: Hands, mouth and nose, face, arms, head and ears, feet

questions.q: Extend: what do we say before wudu?
Stretch: why do we wash in order?
questions.a: The Prophet ﷺ did it in order, and we follow him.

questions.q: What do we wash straight after the arms?
questions.a: A) We wipe the head. After the arms we wipe the head and ears, then wash the feet.

questions.q: Think again: why wash when we are already clean?
questions.a: To be pure and ready to meet Allah in salah.
